entities.name: Bazaar of Bassorah
entities.description: Marketplace in Bassorah on Rabiah the Infinite, the second largest bazaar in Rabiah, where items from other planes sometimes turn up.

entities.name: Shahrazad
entities.description: Namesake of the 'Shahrazad's gifts' that fall into the hands of those who need them most.

entities.name: Nomad Taysir
entities.description: Found the Dervish Taysir and Raghib at the bazaar.

entities.name: Dervish Taysir
entities.description: Found by the Nomad Taysir at the bazaar.

entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: Found by the Nomad Taysir at the bazaar.

events.summary: The Nomad Taysir finds the Dervish Taysir and Raghib at the Bazaar of Bassorah.
events.quote: The Bazaar of Bassorah was where the Nomad Taysir found the Dervish Taysir and Raghib .

relations.quote: The Bazaar of Bassorah was a marketplace in the city of Bassorah on Rabiah the Infinite , near the Mosque Quarter.
